label: At one moment, presence, received esse and giving being read the holding vocabulary at esse
paraphrase: OPEN analyst interpretation bridge, attribution deferred: at moment t of history v of the timed concurrent-actualization vocabulary, (a) whatever is in act as to being is present at t (h.IsAt v x t); (b) whatever could lack being has its esse received in some principle (DEF-ESSE-RECEIVED-IN); (c) whatever gives x being at t (BeingGiving.GivesAt v z x t, definition 158301bc-9585-4145-be60-34f08c9f922c, STRICT reading) presently actualizes x as to being (Holding.ActualizesNow z x esse). It reads the untimed holding vocabulary as the present slice of the timed one; (b) is the one substantive clause, and it runs one way: whatever could lack being has received esse ('not its own being' in the received-esse sense); the converse is not claimed.
